items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: I'm working in the coal mine, and the first one with Lee Darcy. I did quite a few albums.

ctx.x: Did you do any work with Alan Toussaint? Yeah.
I'm working in the coal mine, and the first one with Lee Darcy. I did quite a few albums.
Roger Pony, were you on that? No, I wasn't on Roger Pony. But I'm working in the coal mine.
